title: Rating/Routing Shipments

children:
Routing and rating determine which carrier will transport a shipment. 
 They are run during a wave. First, routing determines if a particular 
 routing guide should be applied to a shipment. If a routing guide should 
 be applied to the shipment, the system will assign the carrier on the 
 guide to the shipment. The system then selects a carrier to transport 
 a shipment or container, based on predefined parameters. Then, the rating process provides an estimate of how much a carrier 
 will charge to transport a container or shipment. In addition, if a carrier 
 is not already assigned to a container/shipment, rating will select a 
 carrier based on cost. Rating is an optional step. If you are shipping 
 with an LTL carrier, the rate is applied to the shipment. If you are shipping 
 with a parcel carrier, the rate is applied to the container.
The following is discussed in this topic:
Routing a Shipment from the Shipment Insight Screen

You can perform rating automatically during the wave cycle. You can 
 add rating as a wave step in the Wave Step Window.

When you ship confirm a shipment in the Shipment Insight screen, the system 
 will automatically perform rating if 
 the shipment has not previously been rated. Note that the system will 
 re-rate the shipment    only if 
 your rating profile has the "Re-Rate at Ship Confirm" checkbox 
 selected.
Routing a Shipment from the Shipment Insight Screen...

You can use the Shipment Insight screen to manually route a shipment. This is especially helpful if you change something about the shipment (e.g. weight, destination) and need to route it with its new properties.
Access the Shipment Insight and select the shipment.
Choose the Route action. The system will route the shipment.

To route automatically during a wave, define routing as a wave step. 
 Defining routing guide records that will accommodate the shipments. When 
 the wave is run, it will perform routing for all shipments accepted by 
 a routing guide record.
